correctness.rationale: Kirchhoff modulo three forces right-shore column sum a/2 and row congruence t mod 3. Gale–Ryser proves every admissible row vector exists. Ryser interchanges give full reachability within each vector and invariance separates vectors. Inclusion–exclusion yields exact sector counts; all-identical columns characterize isolated states; a complete 27-case exact Eisenstein-character filter gives the total-state formula. The included checker tests the exhaustive 27 cases, exact DP through t=10 and full reconfiguration graphs through t=4.

value.rationale: These are natural first even complete-bipartite families with a thin left shore. The result upgrades previously structural 3-flow connectivity tests into exact all-order numbers, every component cardinality, isolated-flow criteria and total-state growth. Its t mod 3 plateaus and t=3 first fragmentation (19 components) show a substantive arithmetic transition, not an arbitrary case table.
